_meta.notes: AMENDMENT to the October interim. The FORM checks 'Seven days before a general election' (clerk listing says 'October'); the amendment 'Yes' box is marked with a typed X and the 'date of report' line is left BLANK. Signed 1/30/15, clerk-stamped JAN 30 2015, but the Summary Page header keeps the original report date 10/28/2014. Changes relative to the original (key b1d2b7ad): Line 2 Column A rose $6.00 (20,462.41 -> 20,468.41), Line 1 Column B rose $62.00 (45,204.43 -> 45,266.43), Line 2 Column B rose $68.00 (39,329.03 -> 39,397.03) and Line 7 fell $6.00 (5,875.40 -> 5,869.40); Lines 1A, 3 and 5 are unchanged. The amended Column A arithmetic checks out (26,337.81 - 20,468.41 = 5,869.40).

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: The on-form Schedule A/B pages (3,4) print only 'See Attached' with an EMPTY 'SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE' cell and a filled TOTAL, so there is no per-page subtotal gate. Both TOTAL gates fired and passed: A p5 10,878.97 + p6 3,939.85 = 14,818.82 (printed); B p7 17,741.22 + p8 2,727.19 = 20,468.41 (printed).

itemized.notes: 8-page PDF, pages in order. p1 cover / p2 Summary Page / p3 Schedule A form ('See Attached') / p4 Schedule B form ('See Attached') / p5-6 Schedule A attachment / p7-8 Schedule B attachment. The attachment is LANDSCAPE, rendered portrait by poppler and rotated 90 degrees COUNTER-CLOCKWISE to read (the opposite sign from the McAdams filing in this same chunk - the sign is per file). PRIVACY: the entire mailing-address block on the Schedule A attachment is a solid black COUNTY REDACTION - there is no city or state printed anywhere on it, so donor_city/donor_state are blank with 'redacted' noted on every row. Contributor names are printed in TWO columns (First, Last) and are joined here; organization contributors have the First column empty and their whole name in the second column. The sheet also carries an Occupation/Employer column with no schema field - recorded verbatim per row note. Ten rows are the filer's own 'Aggregate Contribution of $50 or Less' lines, transcribed verbatim as printed (not fabricated donors). Row 1 (Steve Nelson $319.18) carries a far-right marker 'Loan' and is mirrored by the 10/27/2014 'Loan Repayment' expenditure. In-kind: 6 contributions / 6 expenditures; they DO count toward the printed totals (both sides close exactly with them included). Cover: the 'Seven days before a general election' interim box is checked AND the amendment box is ticked 'Yes' - matching the listing label 'Oct14 Amendment'. The cover was signed and stamped RECEIVED JAN 30 2015.
